description: This file defines the GuarantorDomainService interface, specifying methods related to guarantor management in loan accounts such as releasing, validating, assigning guarantors, and transferring funds.

classes.name: GuarantorDomainService
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for handling guarantor-related operations in the loan portfolio.

methods.name: releaseGuarantor
methods.description: Releases a guarantor based on provided guarantor funding details and transaction date.

methods.name: validateGuarantorBusinessRules
methods.description: Validates business rules associated with guarantors for a given loan.

methods.name: assignGuarantor
methods.description: Assigns a guarantor with specified funding details and transaction date.

methods.name: transferFundsFromGuarantor
methods.description: Transfers funds from the guarantor for a specified loan.
